user.title: Madoka
user.description: Add your Madoka-controlled air conditioners as a list of devices.

data_description.devices: YAML list of devices, e.g. `[{name: Living Room, mac: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, modes: [off, cool, heat]}]`. `modes` is optional and defaults to `[off, cool, heat]`; use `[off, auto]` for units that only support power on/off (no cool/heat selection).

error.invalid_devices: Could not parse the devices list. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Madoka integration instance is allowed.

pairing_required.title: {name} air conditioner needs pairing confirmed
pairing_required.description: This is a notification from your Madoka air conditioner, "{name}". Check the unit's display for a pairing code and confirm it there. This clears automatically once it connects.
